about.body: The TDV6/SDV6 is a V6 (60° angle), 3.0L (2,993 cc), Diesel engine used across Land Rover's 3 model range, in production 2004–2019. We rebuild every TDV6/SDV6 to original specification, replacing worn timing components, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard.

byModel.body: The TDV6/SDV6 is fitted across Discovery, Range Rover, Range Rover Sport — see the full applications table above for exact variants, generations and years.

compatibility.body: Because the TDV6/SDV6 is fitted across multiple Land Rover models, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation and specification. We confirm by registration or VIN before quoting or supplying anything.
